notes.title: Get Ready to Enter the Arena
notes.content:
We’re incredibly excited to announce the launch of our brand new game, Soccer Manager Arena.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308484/9831f14792745de69ea8c94a722349f1d8811120.jpg[/img]

Soccer Manager Arena is a fast paced, PVP, real time football game, where you compete against others from across the globe. As you win trophies, you unlock new levels and gain access to different iconic arenas and other elite players with different special abilities. You can form a league with friends or others from around the world, share XP and help improve each other’s players whilst leading your team to victory.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26308484/028ddeb0858f153febac41937afcb280307348a4.jpg[/img]

Before the rest of the world enter the Arena, we would like to thank all of our Beta testers. Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the development of the game.

Get ready to enter the Arena!
